enchantments.tooltip: Druidic Survival Mastery: While in Wild Shape, you receive a Primal bonus to damage equal to half the number of Wilderness Lore feats you have.
Strength +12: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +12 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Seeker +12: Provides a +12 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +12 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
